clippings.speaker: Bill Murray
clippings.quote: Harold Ramis and I together did the 'National Lampoon Show' off Broadway, 'Meatballs,' 'Stripes,' 'Caddyshack,' 'Ghostbusters' and 'Groundhog Day.' … He earned his keep on this planet. God bless him.
clippings.title: Bill Murray Opens Up About Death of Harold Ramis
clippings.context: Murray's statement on Ramis's death, first obtained by Time magazine and reported by ABC News.

clippings.speaker: Bill Murray
clippings.quote: In the editing, I think we had a difference of opinion. We had a difference about the script too. That gets a little personal and that's not for sharing with everyone. But I just felt like a lot of what was in there was unnecessary. I thought there was a lot of overwriting in it. And I held Harold responsible for that.
clippings.title: Bill Murray talks about mending fences with Harold Ramis on Grantland podcast
clippings.context: Murray on the rift that began on the Groundhog Day set, speaking on a Grantland podcast with John Walsh, as reported by the Sun-Times.

clippings.speaker: Bill Murray
clippings.quote: And it was great. It was a beautiful day, obviously….There was sadness. I got to his beautiful home in the suburbs of Chicago. I went there. I sort of just showed up. I wasn't expected.
clippings.title: Bill Murray talks about mending fences with Harold Ramis on Grantland podcast
clippings.context: Murray on visiting the ailing Ramis in Glencoe to make peace before his death, from a Grantland podcast reported by the Sun-Times.

clippings.speaker: Harold Ramis
clippings.quote: He redefines quirky! [ Laughs ] He is the most fascinating and talented pain in the ass we know. … Hey, he couldn't be the actor he is if he didn't have that explosive potential. We watch him with such fascination because we genuinely don't know what he's going to do.
clippings.title: Harold Ramis 'Busts Bill Murray
clippings.context: Ramis, asked whether Murray is as quirky as people say, in an interview pegged to the Ghostbusters DVD set.

clippings.speaker: Harold Ramis
clippings.quote: In Danny's original script the characters weren't well defined; part of the fun was tailoring them for Bill, Danny and me. What we came up with was that Danny was the heart, I was the brain and Bill was the mouth of the Ghostbusters.
clippings.title: Harold Ramis 'Busts Bill Murray
clippings.context: Ramis on shaping the Ghostbusters roles around himself, Aykroyd and Murray.

clippings.speaker: Harold Ramis
clippings.quote: Bill has kind of moved on in his life since Groundhog Day. I've had no contact with him. I did ask him to appear in my new film, The Ice Harvest, [but] I didn't hear back from him. Too bad, he would have been great in it.
clippings.title: Harold Ramis 'Busts Bill Murray
clippings.context: Ramis, asked if they would work together again, during the long estrangement after Groundhog Day.

notes: Ramis's 2004 New Yorker profile quotes ("irrationally mean") and 2009 A.V. Club interview not fetched/verified; Fresh Air 2014 transcript had only passing Groundhog Day mention.
